scope: Seven original native capability requirements, approved exact policy boundaries and all original measured equal-quality Java-time targets. Bounded readiness does not imply whole-Timefold/JVM equivalence, arbitrary-scale speed or universal finite-budget optimality.

requirements.label: Independent native solver and Community attribution
requirements.limits: Independent Rust implementation; no formal clean-room or whole-Timefold equivalence claim; crates remain unpublished.

requirements.label: Scores and independently checked arithmetic
requirements.limits: Exact default arithmetic and explicitly selected wrapping/binary64 policies remain distinct; no cross-runtime transcendental equivalence.

requirements.label: Basic/list/mixed models, moves, pins, ranges and rollback
requirements.limits: Native equality/IDs and physical k-opt behavior; no private Java endpoint arrays, reflection or getter bug compatibility.

requirements.label: Construction, heuristic improvement, repair and exact optimization
requirements.limits: Only exhausted exact search with valid bounds proves optimality; finite budgets retain best results and seeds do not establish identical Java traces.

requirements.label: Incremental scoring, streams, collectors and derived values
requirements.limits: Explicit native policies and every reference error remain visible; user callback side effects and allocation aborts are outside rollback guarantees.

requirements.label: Configured applications and solver services
requirements.limits: Roster planted certificate and mixed independent small optimum/larger feasible certificate only; cooperative scheduling and no arbitrary-scale quality guarantee.

requirements.label: Visual test and performance dashboard
requirements.limits: Source-bound desktop/mobile rendering and original observations; source-method counts are not runtime invocation or native requirement counts.
